name: Welcome to PartnerIQ
description: Sent when a new user or organization registers on PartnerIQ.
defaultPreheader: Your PartnerIQ workspace is ready. Let’s set up your first partner program.
bodyTemplate:
Your PartnerIQ workspace is ready

Hi Alex, welcome to PartnerIQ! Your dedicated workspace for Acme Growth Inc has been provisioned and is ready for use.

PartnerIQ empowers modern SaaS and commerce teams to launch partner programs, automate affiliate onboarding, track conversions accurately, and disburse commissions with zero friction.

Approx. Location London, United Kingdom
